errors.evidence: The description identifies the color for '社交' (Social) as '浅蓝色' (light blue), the same color it used for '生活工作' (Life/Work). However, the chart shows two distinct shades of blue for these categories.

The description identifies the color for '生理活动' (Physiological Activities) as '深蓝色' (dark blue), the same color it used for '其他' (Other). The chart shows '生理活动' as a dark teal/blue-green, while '其他' is a true dark blue.

errors.text_span: 切片按比例大小大致呈递减顺序排列
errors.evidence: The description claims the slices of the left chart are arranged roughly in decreasing order of size. This is incorrect. The clockwise order of percentages starting from the largest slice is 23.3%, 16.91%, 9.9%, 6.6%, 19.38%, 8.87%, 5.57%, 9.48%. The presence of 19.38% after 6.6% breaks any decreasing sequence.

errors.text_span: 从视觉上按顺时针方向依次为：方位改变（橙色，18.09%）、交通（深棕色，5.32%）、判断（深灰蓝色，8.51%）、司法（深灰色，10.64%）、文教（深灰色，未标注百分比但可估算约4.26%）、心理活动（紫红色，10.64%）、战争（深红色，9.57%）、争斗（深紫色，9.57%）、帮助（橙色，4.26%）和表情（浅橙色，5.32%）
errors.evidence: The description claims to list the slices of the right pie chart in clockwise order, but the listed order does not match the visual arrangement in the chart. For example, in the chart, '帮助' (Help) is followed by '表情' (Expression), which is followed by '方位改变' (Change of direction), but the description lists them in a different, jumbled sequence.

errors.text_span: 文教（深灰色，未标注百分比但可估算约4.26%）
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates the presence of the category '文教' (Culture/Education) in the right-hand pie chart. This category only appears in the left-hand chart.

The description hallucinates the presence of the category '战争' (War) in the right-hand pie chart. This category only appears in the left-hand chart. The percentage 9.57% belongs to the '争斗' (Struggle) category.
The description's list of slices for the right-hand chart omits two categories that are present in the figure: '物态事态' (State of things) with 23.4% and '际遇' (Encounter) with 5.32%.
The description states the percentage for '交通' (Traffic) is 5.32%, but the chart shows it is 4.26%.
The description identifies the color for '判断' (Judgment) as '深灰蓝色' (dark grey-blue), but the chart shows it as a light blue-green color.
